title: The printed count sheet leaves out an untracked part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SHEET-T1, 2 in {Bin-A}) and {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SHEET-T2, 4 in {Bin-A}) are active and tracked at {Location-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SHEET-U1) is active and untracked at {Location-A}, with 6 in {Bin-A}.
  • All three part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SHEET-), which is typed in the Inventory search.
  • No Cycle count is in progress on the Inventory list.
custom_steps:
1. Click the ⋮ actions menu.
  2. Click Cycle count.
  3. Click the printer icon in the toolbar.
  4. Read the parts listed on the count sheet that opens.
  5. Click Cancel in the toolbar to leave Cycle count.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The count sheet lists {Part-A} and {Part-B} (2 parts) and does not list {Part-C}.
  • Step 5: Cycle count ends and the ⋮ menu is back in the toolbar.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S5-R13, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.7 (Cycle count leaves it out; printer icon) and tracking-note-6, 13 Oct copy.
